evals.prompt: We're choosing between Next.js and Remix for our new marketing site. SEO matters, team knows React but not both frameworks. Should we document this decision?
evals.expected_output: Runs the full ADR procedure: gate check (3 conditions), gathers context, documents 2-4 alternatives including status quo, states decision with rationale/consequences/mitigations, produces markdown ADR template with Alternatives Considered table.

assertions.name: gate_check_present
assertions.description: Response confirms the 3-condition threshold (hard to reverse, surprising without context, result of real trade-off)

assertions.name: alternatives_table_present
assertions.description: Response includes an Alternatives Considered table with Pros/Cons/Risks columns

assertions.name: status_quo_included
assertions.description: Status quo is listed as one of the alternatives in the table

assertions.name: adr_template_present
assertions.description: Response outputs a markdown ADR template with Context, Decision, Consequences, Alternatives, Mitigations, Links sections

assertions.name: chosen_option_in_table
assertions.description: The chosen option appears in the alternatives table alongside rejected options

evals.prompt: Document how our current auth middleware works in the README so new engineers can understand it.
evals.expected_output: This is documenting existing code, not a decision. Should decline — redirect to README or inline comment, not produce an ADR.

assertions.name: no_adr_produced
assertions.description: Response does NOT produce an ADR template or Alternatives Considered table

assertions.name: redirect_or_decline
assertions.description: Response declines ADR and recommends README or inline comment instead

assertions.name: no_gate_check
assertions.description: Response does NOT run the 3-condition gate check

evals.prompt: Should we name the new config key 'timeoutMs' or 'timeout_ms'?
evals.expected_output: Trivial naming choice with no reversal cost or trade-off. Should decline — use inline comment, not ADR.

assertions.name: no_adr_produced
assertions.description: Response does NOT produce an ADR template

assertions.name: declines_as_trivial
assertions.description: Response explicitly states this is a trivial choice not worthy of an ADR

assertions.name: redirect_to_inline
assertions.description: Response recommends inline comment or team convention doc instead
